title: VTT document boundaries and adversarial benchmarks
summary: Documentation research only: no competitor attack was executed and no product-specific security defect is established. Foundry documentation is pinned to v13, not claimed latest. Existing test references mean source assertions were inspected; future graph/bus/voice tests are not passing implementations.

claims.statement: Foundry documents parent/embedded relationships and ownership APIs. Item.isOwned describes embedding, not the current user’s authorization. Synthetic Token Actors require distinct identity from world Actors.

Scenes can reference journals and embedded objects; journals contain pages; RollTable operations can recurse or emit chat. None of this establishes ARGO actor knowledge, historical acquisition or authoritative random draws.

AI Dungeon documents finite context assembly and memory facilities; context may be trimmed. Its multiplayer documentation describes simultaneous character inputs. Neither proves cross-tenant leakage, voice corruption or that the product is stateless.
Sycophancy, loot inflation, secret leakage and forced choices are attack hypotheses to measure, not findings proven against all competitors.

proposals.title: Versioned adapter provenance and headless adversarial matrix

fields.name: rights_provenance
fields.meaning: Separate permission to import from permission to disclose

rules: Actor -> entity and scoped capability mapping; Item -> parent-qualified custody proposal; Scene -> authorized geography/view; JournalEntry -> typed source/claims; RollTable -> ruleset data, not independent RNG authority.
Foundry permissions never substitute for actor/tenant/rights/time authorization.
No live competitor verdicts: use synthetic canaries and deterministic oracles. Canary absence alone does not prove absence of every semantic leak.
Keep future voice tests parked until headless authority, graph and bus gates pass; present source references are not proof of an implemented voice stack.

benchmarks.title: Unauthorized narrator context
benchmarks.given: Stale/private FOREIGN_SECRET claim and clean authenticated refresh.
benchmarks.when: Narrator attempts generation, including a retry after shared-object mutation.
then: Captured vendor requests contain no FOREIGN_SECRET or foreign world.
benchmarks.oracle: Captured request bytes; tests were inspected, not rerun by this research helper.

benchmarks.title: Illegal loot/custody
benchmarks.given: Actor does not hold the requested object; prose claims a reward.
benchmarks.when: Submit unauthorized custody transfer or render claimed reward.
benchmarks.oracle: Canonical state/event counts; general loot catalog adapter remains future.

benchmarks.title: Deterministic replay
benchmarks.given: Fixed genesis and causal/epistemic/RNG event sequence.
benchmarks.when: Rebuild each prefix and tamper an event.
benchmarks.oracle: Byte comparison and deterministic exception assertions.

benchmarks.title: Refusal remains optional
benchmarks.given: Each Fate or subscriber is offered a refused/declined action.
benchmarks.when: Process leave/refuse or an empty candidate list.
then: No forced quest, gift or canonical mutation.
benchmarks.oracle: Proposal list and ledger event count.

benchmarks.title: Future voice collision
benchmarks.given: A owns turn; B overlaps; A final is duplicated; narration epoch7 cancelled.
then: One A proposal; explicit busy response for B.
No extra commit from duplicate; no late epoch7 audio.
benchmarks.oracle: Entire voice/gateway trace fixture is deferred, not implemented.

open_questions: Full cross-tenant cache matrix and graph/bus replay workloads require new executable fixtures.
Foundry v13 import mapping is future work, not an integration currently shipped.
